$comment: Mural home score (ADR 0246, bipe-chat/bipe#1044). The formula and the tie-break are in registries/home-score.json. score: each input alone as a list of one chat; compare the score (2 places), the tier and the reason. plan: a list of chats; compare the order, each score and each tier. tier null: no tile. All IDs are fixtures. A case without modelAttention and modelDue has the model fields absent. Swift BipeHomeScore, Kotlin BipeHomeScore and the web lib/home-score.mjs must give the same values. The expected values come from a separate implementation, not from tools/lib/home-score.mjs.
